cards.brief: Ultraviolette broke ground on a ₹779 crore electric vehicle plant in Hosur. The plant is designed for initial annual capacity of 250,000 vehicles, scalable to 500,000, and will make the company’s upcoming electric scooters and motorcycles.

cards.headline: Ultraviolette breaks ground on ₹779 crore electric vehicle plant in Hosur
cards.mechanism: Making scooters and motorcycles at one site could spread factory costs across more vehicles if sales support higher output.
cards.watch: Watch for a commissioning date and the first production guidance for each vehicle line.

catalyst_review: No distinct material event for Saturday, 28 November was supported by the captured RSS. The Cabinet and Congress strategy meetings, Tata hearing, Mahanadi debut and Wayanad declaration are Friday, 27 November. The special Parliament sitting and Tata Sons board meeting are on 30 November. The Vivo sale, Supriya board meeting, Apple store and other dated events are in December.
hero: The government projected 167.14 million tonnes of kharif foodgrains, and the RBI accepted ₹8,003 crore in its first state bond switch auction. Tata Trusts took the chairman’s reappointment to court, while Mizuho and Avendus combined operations. The Supreme Court set a deadline for food warning labels. Ultraviolette broke ground on a Hosur EV plant, and Vodafone Idea decided against renewing part of its Mumbai spectrum.
